about_the_game:
DECK COLLECTOR is the ultimate card collecting simulator designed for those who love to rip open packs of cards! Whether you’re looking to build your collection, chase those rare finds, or to just relax and enjoy the excitement of opening packs of cards, DECK COLLECTOR will fully immerse you in the collectible card world!

Organize Your Collection

It doesn’t just stop at ripping open packs! You can place your cards in a selection of 2D binders. Various binder sizes are included to organize your collection anywhere from a small 2x2 binder, all the way to the extra large 4x4 binder. There are even customization features to personalize your binder!

Just Like Real Life!

DECK COLLECTOR was made with realism and performance in mind. The game uses PBR graphics to simulate the look and feel of the real world. The foil shaders were designed to mimic the glimmer of the iconic holographic cards. Rotate the card and watch it come to life!

 

Settings! Settings! Settings!

A multitude of settings have been implemented into the game to allow for user controllability. Choose your color, adjust the pacing, and fine-tune the camera settings to your liking.

 

Constant Updates

The game will constantly evolve into a bigger, better game. With constant updates, new features, and surprises that will be implemented within the game to enhance the gameplay and overall playability. Difficulty modes, 3D binders, custom rooms, an ABUNDANCE of new cards and sets, more settings, player customizations, advanced play modes, VR support, Steam achievements, and SO MUCH MORE are currently on the “to-do” list while the game journeys through its Early Release Mode.

 

Features

  • Build your collection by placing cards in customizable 2D binders.

  • Multiple sets, packs, and decks of cards to open.

  • View each card in stunning detail in the Card Viewer through the Deck Collection scene.

  • User controllability through the settings page.

  • All settings files are in plain text format for easy editing.

  • Realistic graphics using PBR.

  • View your progress of each set and deck.

  • A multitude of stats regarding your most pulled card, most opened set, worth of the most valued card, etc…

  • Pick your color to colorize your game!

  • Changeable images for some backgrounds.

  • Image and text import style mechanics.

  • Control the look of the game with camera settings (color adjustments, bloom, depth of field, vignette, etc…).

  • Free-play style gameplay, open as many packs as you want!

  • Jump in now to crack open some packs!

short_description: DECK COLLECTOR is an immersive collectible card simulator dedicated to those who love to crack open packs of cards! Rip open unlimited packs of cards, place them in 2D binders, adjust the camera settings for ultra realism, animate your favorite cards, and complete your full set of cards!
